title: Base Power reviews track
description: A heading with a star score and a green link, then a sideways track that mixes white review cards (yellow stars, a five-line quote, the reviewer) with wider dark photo cards holding a member's pull quote and a lime link. Swipe it, or step through with two small square arrow buttons; it snaps card by card.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows only; the track swipes and snaps without it
story cards carry the dark class themselves
